description: NOT a faithful LoneStar DMR port: exercises a worklist + irregular-gather pattern over synthetic vertex triples (bad-triangle detection + vertex nudging toward circumcenters), but does NOT perform DMR's cavity re-triangulation and does not change mesh topology. Faithful DMR needs real mesh data structures / Delaunay input (follow-up work).

scaling_param.name: num_triangles
scaling_param.description: Number of triangles in the synthetic mesh

non_scaling_params.name: min_angle
non_scaling_params.description: Minimum angle threshold in degrees for quality check

non_scaling_params.name: max_refine_iterations
non_scaling_params.description: Maximum number of check-refine iterations per run
